name: yf_institutional_holders
description:
Largest institutional holders of one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance institutional_holders), usually the top 10.
Returns: {symbol, holders: [{Date Reported, Holder, pctHeld, Shares, Value, pctChange}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Mutual funds: yf_mutual_fund_holders; insider vs institution percentages: yf_major_holders; 13F detail: openbb_institutional_ownership. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
